summary: Create a proxy and a revoke function whose closure clears the proxy target/handler exactly once.

target.notes: Use the JavaScript object-model runtime. Proxy semantics require trap lookup, handler calls, target internal methods, revocation checks, and invariant enforcement.

semantics.return_value: ordinary object with proxy and revoke properties
semantics.revoke: sets [[ProxyTarget]] and [[ProxyHandler]] to null; returns undefined
semantics.idempotence: subsequent revoke calls have no additional effect

caveats: Do not model Proxy as a plain C# decorator or Dictionary wrapper; observable internal-method interception and invariants must be preserved.
